\caption{Child age-band records excluded from the primary analysis because a covariate was unavailable, by survey. In all, 822,434 of 8,624,561 eligible records (9.5\%) and 13,296 of 122,043 deaths (10.9\%) were excluded, from 27 surveys in 17 countries; 25 surveys were excluded entirely. The covariate shown is the first found to be missing. These records are included in the multiple-imputation sensitivity analysis.}
